text.tspan: Income or consumption of the poorest and richest 10%2025
Shown is the income or consumption per person per day at the cutoff to the poorest 10% and richest 10% in
each country. This data is adjusted for inflation and differences in living costs between countries.
Income or consumption of the richest 10% (international-$ in 2021 prices; plotted on a logarithmic axis)
Income or consumption of the poorest 10% (international-$ in 2021 prices; plotted on a logarithmic axis)
Data source: World Bank Poverty and Inequality Platform (2026)
Note: This data is expressed in international-$ at 2021 prices. Depending on the country and year, it relates to income (measured after taxes
and benefits) or to consumption, per capita. Where data for 2025 is unavailable, the value from the closest year between 2020 and 2026 is
